description: This file contains functions for handling symbolic links and directory path checks, including caching mechanisms for filesystem stat calls, and functions for scheduling and removing directories, specifically related to symlink and directory existence checks in a Git-related context.

methods.name: threaded_check_leading_path
methods.description: Checks if the leading component of a path is a symlink or directory, with caching.

methods.name: threaded_has_dirs_only_path
methods.description: Checks if all components of a path are directories, with caching.

methods.name: longest_path_match
methods.description: Finds the length of the longest common prefix of two paths.

methods.name: reset_lstat_cache
methods.description: Resets the cache used for lstat checks.

methods.name: lstat_cache_matchlen
methods.description: Performs cache-aware lstat or stat on path components to determine symlink or directory status.

methods.name: threaded_has_symlink_leading_path
methods.description: Checks if a path has a leading symlink component.

methods.name: has_symlink_leading_path
methods.description: Checks if a path has a leading symlink component (public API).

methods.name: check_leading_path
methods.description: Checks the leading path component for existence and type.

methods.name: threaded_check_leading_path
methods.description: Checks if the leading path component exists and is a directory or symlink, with warning on error.

methods.name: has_dirs_only_path
methods.description: Checks if all path components are directories (public API).

methods.name: threaded_has_dirs_only_path
methods.description: Checks if all path components are directories, with caching.

methods.name: schedule_dir_for_removal
methods.description: Schedules directories for removal, managing nested directory deletions.

methods.name: lstat_cache_aware_rmdir
methods.description: Removes a directory and invalidates cache if successful.
